fields.description: What the mission needs, in the society's own words.
fields.label: Resource

fields.description: What it is for and any specification that matters — the detail a procurement officer would otherwise have to ring somebody about.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: When the mission needs it by. Optional: much of what a mission needs is simply needed throughout.
fields.label: Needed On

fields.description: The unit these are counted in — ERPNext's own UOM list, so a resource line and a purchase of the same thing are counted the same way.
fields.label: Unit

fields.description: The currency this line is estimated in. Left empty, the site's own default is used.
fields.label: Currency

fields.description: The planning estimate for one of them. An estimate, not an accounting entry: nothing here reaches a ledger.
fields.label: Unit Cost

fields.description: Quantity times unit cost. Recomputed on every save of the terms of reference, so it cannot drift from the two numbers it came from.
fields.label: Total Cost

fields.description: Where the money for this line has got to. Left blank — the shipped state — means nobody has recorded it, which is not the same as unfunded.
fields.label: Funding Status

fields.description: Whose money this line is expected to come from, in the society's own words. The project carries the programme's donor; this is for a line funded from somewhere else.
fields.label: Donor or Funding Source
